title: expanders-vertex-expansion widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the vertex-expansion explorer on the expanders topic. Combines a graph-family <select> picker, an action <button> (clear selection), and a clickable SVG of a graph layout: clicking a vertex toggles it in/out of the selected set S, and the readout reports |N(S)|/|S|. The combination of select + button + click-on-SVG is unique on the page (clickable-graph has no form controls; parametric-plot has no click-on-SVG semantics) so this slug captures the gesture as one unit.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper.

svgId.description: DOM id for the host <svg> element.

outputId.description: DOM id for the <div class="readout"> companion.

title.description: Header title (also used as <title> child of <svg>).

svgTitle.description: <title> child of the <svg>. Defaults to the widget title.

outputInitial.description: Initial inner HTML of the readout <div>. Defaults to ' '.

buttons.description: Action buttons (e.g. clear selection). Rendered in the same row as pick.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ comment placed between the leading <script> tag and the IIFE opener.

bodyScript.x-artifact: script body is bespoke; portable consumers should implement their own click-toggle + N(S) draw logic from {pick.options, buttons} + their own graph layouts
bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Verbatim JS statements that go inside `(function(){\n…\n})();` — wires up the select, the buttons, and the SVG click handlers; computes N(S) and updates the readout.
